walkthrough:
Differentiate the spherical volume formula with respect to radius $r$:
$$\frac{dV}{dr} = 4\pi r^2$$

Apply the chain rule for connected rates of change:
$$\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{\frac{dV}{dt}}{\frac{dV}{dr}} = \frac{50}{4\pi r^2}$$

Evaluate at $r = 10\text{ cm}$:
$$\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{50}{4\pi(10^2)} = \frac{50}{400\pi} = \frac{1}{8\pi} \approx 0.0398\text{ cm s}^{-1} \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
